## User Story

As a [type of user],
I need [feature or capability],
so that [benefit or reason].

## Acceptance Criteria

### Scenario 1
- Given [initial condition]
- When [action]
- Then [expected result]

### Scenario 2
- Given [initial condition]
- When [action]
- Then [expected result]

## Priority
High / Medium / Low

## Story Points
1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 8
